evidence_quotes: Norges Idrettsforbund (NIF) har innført nye krav til medlemsregistrering i norsk idrett.
For vår klubb vil overføringen skje torsdag 16. april.
data.reason: The article provides instructions and information to members regarding new registration requirements from the Norwegian Olympic and Paralympic Committee and Confederation of Sports (NIF), rather than reporting a specific development or action taken by the club itself.
